notes.title: Patch Notes – 22/08/2025
notes.content:
[p][b]Hey everyone![/b][/p][p]A new patch for the Mistaken demo is now live! This update focuses on QoL improvements, bug fixes, balancing changes, and a few new items to discover.
[/p][p][b]Major Changes[/b][/p][p][i][u]Controller Support[/u][/i][/p][p]Mistaken now has controller support![/p][p]This required major input changes, so expect some rough edges and future fine-tuning (like remapping). Steam Deck should work, but haven’t tested yet.[/p][p][/p][p][i][u]New Settings Options[/u][/i][/p][p]The settings menu has been expanded with more customization, including:[/p][list][*][p]Toggle for screen shake,[/p][/*][*][p]Toggle for controller rumble,[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Option to always display certain UI elements (buffs, affliction levels, etc.)[/p][/*][*][p]Settings are now also accessible from the main menu, not just in-game.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][i][u]Pause During Menus[/u][/i][/p][p]The game now pauses when using inventories or menus, making combat item swaps less stressful.[/p][p]Not everyone may like this, so a toggle will come later.[/p][p][/p][p][i][u]New Content and New Items[/u][/i][/p][p]A beginner magic weapon can now be crafted using tick remains and sticks (good luck experimenting!).,[/p][list][*][p]Several new Cartifacts have been added to make the early game more impactful and rewarding.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][i][u]Visitor System Changes[/u][/i][/p][list][*][p]Visitors now appear every hour instead of only once per day, still based on your settlement level.,[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]The Cartifact Trader now always offers 3 different trades instead of just one.,[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][i][u]Balancing[/u][/i][/p][list][*][p]Melee weapons have been slightly buffed.,[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Some ranged and magic weapons have been slightly nerfed.,[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][i][u]UI & Tooltips[/u][/i][/p][list][*][p]tem tooltips now factor in your stats when displaying damage and speed.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Tooltips have been improved with clearer details and color coding for better readability.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b][i]What’s Next[/i][/b][/p][p]This will likely be the last major demo patch for Mistaken (aside from small hotfixes).[/p][p]From here, the focus shifts toward developing and preparing for Early Access—exciting times ahead![/p][p]Thanks for playing, and until next time, take care! (edited)[/p][p][/p][p][/p]

tags.feature: Mistaken now has controller support!
Toggle for screen shake,
Toggle for controller rumble,
Option to always display certain UI elements (buffs, affliction levels, etc.)
Settings are now also accessible from the main menu, not just in-game.
The game now pauses when using inventories or menus, making combat item swaps less stressful.
A beginner magic weapon can now be crafted using tick remains and sticks (good luck experimenting!.,
Several new Cartifacts have been added to make the early game more impactful and rewarding.

tags.balance_change: Visitors now appear every hour instead of only once per day, still based on your settlement level.,
The Cartifact Trader now always offers 3 different trades instead of just one.,
Melee weapons have been slightly buffed.,
Some ranged and magic weapons have been slightly nerfed.,

notes.title: Patch notes 17-06-2025
notes.content:
[p][b]Steam Next Fest brought a wave of lovely new players to Mistaken — along with a ton of great feedback![/b]
I’m continuing to work hard on improving the game, and while not everything has been addressed just yet, here are the tweaks and features included in the latest patch:[/p][list][*][p][b]Resolution settings[/b] added with improved [b]ultrawide support[/b].
[i](Note: A 16:9 aspect ratio is still recommended for the best visual experience.)[/i][/p][/*][*][p][b]Fishing drops rebalanced[/b] — now include some less desirable items to reduce the frequency of high-value catches. Further tuning may follow.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Health indicators[/b] added to iron ore nodes.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Dashing[/b] now negates damage from [b]Whispers of Affliction[/b] orbs.[/p][/*][*][p]Added [b]sound effects[/b] when equipping/removing gear and scrolling, for improved feedback and clarity.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Tooltips[/b] now correctly update when swapping equipment via right-click.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Enemy spawns during chest swarm events reduced[/b] to ease difficulty spikes.[/p][/*][*][p]It’s no longer possible to equip [b]two of the same amulet[/b] (e.g., two Odd Springs).
[i](This may be relaxed later to allow specific amulet pairings.)[/i][/p][/*][*][p][b]Gathering tools buffed[/b] for slightly faster harvesting — especially noticeable early on.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New characters now start with a "Heavy Stick"[/b], a basic tool that’s slightly better than bare hands, to improve early-game progression.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p][b]Thank you all for playing and supporting Mistaken.[/b]
– [i]Storken[/i][/p]

tags.feature: [b]Resolution settings[/b] added with improved [b]ultrawide support[/b].

tags.balance_change: [b]Fishing drops rebalanced[/b] — now include some less desirable items to reduce the frequency of high-value catches. Further tuning may follow.

tags.bug: [b]Tooltips[/b] now correctly update when swapping equipment via right-click.

tags.balance_change: [b]Enemy spawns during chest swarm events reduced[/b] to ease difficulty spikes.

tags.bug: It’s no longer possible to equip [b]two of the same amulet[/b] (e.g., two Odd Springs).

tags.balance_change: [b]Gathering tools buffed[/b] for slightly faster harvesting — especially noticeable early on.

tags.feature: [b]New characters now start with a "Heavy Stick"[/b], a basic tool that’s slightly better than bare hands, to improve early-game progression.

notes.title: Patch notes
notes.content:
[p][b]New Patch Live![/b][/p][p]After a busy month, I'm back with a fresh update to the demo![/p][p]This patch focuses on balancing, quality-of-life improvements, and introduces a brand new NPC system.[/p][p][b]Highlights:[/b][/p][olist][*][p][b]Wanderer's Beacon
[/b]A new placeable item that, when set in your settlement, gives a daily chance for friendly wanderers to appear.
[/p][/*][*][p][b]Comfort System
[/b]The chance of attracting wanderers is based on your Comfort Level, which you can track in the top-right corner of the screen while at home.[/p][p]Comfort increases by placing furniture and decorative objects in your settlement. Each item shows its comfort value in the tooltip.[/p][p]New craftable furniture has been added to help boost comfort. (You can now also flip furniture and objects by holding Shift while placing.)
[/p][/*][*][p][b]New NPCs
Merp[/b]: A mysterious cartifact trader who will offer you one of his cards in exchange for a another specific card of  his request.[/p][p][b]Brenn[/b]: A veteran blacksmith that offers reforging of items, by default he is not able to reforge high quality results and requires upgrades provided by the player. 

[i]More Npcs are in works..[/i] [/p][/*][/olist][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45491015/de7ef8e58d5707b82ebe46153bc26550aca5745a.png"][/img][/p][p]Check it out![/p]

tags.feature:
- Wanderer's Beacon
A new placeable item that, when set in your settlement, gives a daily chance for friendly wanderers to appear.

- Comfort System
The chance of attracting wanderers is based on your Comfort Level, which you can track in the top-right corner of the screen while at home.
Comfort increases by placing furniture and decorative objects in your settlement. Each item shows its comfort value in the tooltip.
New craftable furniture has been added to help boost comfort. (You can now also flip furniture and objects by holding Shift while placing.)
- Merp: A mysterious cartifact trader who will offer you one of his cards in exchange for a another specific card of his request.
- Brenn: A veteran blacksmith that offers reforging of items, by default he is not able to reforge high quality results and requires upgrades provided by the player.

notes.title: Patch Notes
notes.content:
🐛[b] Bugs[/b]
[list]
[*] Reworked sheep and critter AI — they should now behave less erratically and will attempt to flee the level as intended.

[*] Fixed several issues related to crafting, most importantly one where players could receive more items than intended.

[*] Resolved problems with “Deposit All” and “Pick Up All” functionalities when using chests.

[*] Consumables can now be used from any inventory, not just the action bar.

[*] Potion cooldowns were previously buggy and unreliable — the system has been reworked and should now function properly.

[*] Buff stacking has been a recurring issue across the last few patches. The system has now been adjusted and should finally work as intended.

[*] Fixed a range of translation errors. Some may still remain — apologies for any that were missed.
[/list]

✨ [b]Features[/b]
Added two new inventory functions:

[list]
[*] Quick Stack to Nearby Chests

[*] Sort Inventor
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45491015/b1f15d312b873bd6cb962d905dac1bf7886fc512.png[/img]



Thank you for all the continued feedback and reports!

Cheers!

notes.title: Patch Notes - Difficulty Update & New Features
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45491015/01d96d3cfa0dfd01764ad11e4b864c92b46edfbd.png[/img]


[b]New Feature: Difficulty Selection[/b]
Players can now choose from four difficulty levels when starting a new game. Each difficulty impacts damage taken, enemy health, hunger rate, and loot/gold systems:

[u] Easy[/u]
Player takes 25% less damage

Enemies have 25% less HP

Hunger depletes 50% slower

No gold loss on death

[u] Normal[/u]
Standard values (baseline experience)

[u] Hard[/u]
Player takes 50% more damage

Enemies have 50% more HP

Hunger depletes 50% faster

Enemies drop 50% more gold

Player loses 50% more gold on death

Slightly increased chance for higher quality gear

[u] Mistake[/u]
Player takes 100% more damage

Enemies have 150% more HP

Hunger depletes 100% faster

Enemies drop 100% more gold

All gold is lost on death

Random items from inventory are dropped on death

Moderately increased chance for higher quality gear

Some enemies and bosses can drop unique loot (exclusive to this difficulty)

[u] New Placeable: Target Dummy[/u]
Added a target dummy item that can be placed in the world

Useful for testing weapons, builds, and calculating damage output

 New UI Feature: DPS Counter
A real-time DPS counter has been added

Activates during combat and when hitting target dummies

Helps players analyze and optimize their damage

[b] 1+ Equipment Slot[/b]
Players can now equip a second amulet

Provides more flexibility and combinations for stat bonuses and utility effects

Fixed buff duration

Some enemies had their values balanced

Some Origin balancing

Other small adjustment and fixes.

notes.title: Demo Update and patch note
notes.content:
[b]Patch Notes:[/b]

First of all, I want to thank everyone who has tried out Mistaken and shared their feedback and opinions. Your voices have not gone unheard! While not all suggestions have made it into this first patch, I deeply appreciate your input and do my best to improve Mistaken based on your feedback. Thank you!

This update primarily focuses on fixing various bugs while also adding and adjusting features based on player feedback.

[list]
[*] Crafting stations such as the workbench, furnace, and anvil can now craft multiple items simultaneously, reducing the need for multiple copies of the same station.
Additionally, items like copper ingots can now be withdrawn partially throughout the crafting process, eliminating the need to wait for an entire stack to complete.

[*] A home icon will now appear in the top right corner of the screen when the player is in a home/safe zone. This is intended to better indicate when building is allowed, as many players have found this unclear. (Further adjustments to come.)
Clicking the home icon will also open the tutorial page, which includes information on building.

[*] Several improvements have been made to building controls to enhance structure detection and make removing structures easier.

[*] A dash cooldown has been added.

[*] Chests now correctly store and save Cartifact rarity.

[*] Various minor fixes and tweaks.
[/list]

[i]!Note: Due to changes in the crafting system, old save files may no longer be compatible![/i]
